requirement.description: The Artifact base class is missing the 'loads' attribute which is referenced in script_annotations_util.py. The code attempts to access artifact_annotation.loads but this attribute doesn't exist on the base Artifact class.
requirement.contract: The Artifact class should have a 'loads' attribute that can be used for custom deserialization of artifact data. This attribute should be optional and can be set to a callable function for custom loading logic, similar to how 'loader' attribute works but for deserializing data instead of loading it.

requirement.description: The Artifact base class lacks support for Pydantic model serialization/deserialization in artifact dumping/loading operations. Tests fail when trying to dump/load Pydantic models.
requirement.contract: The Artifact class should support serialization/deserialization of Pydantic models, particularly base models and custom field serializers. This involves implementing proper handling for Pydantic models when they are used as artifacts.

requirement.description: The Artifact base class is missing required attributes and methods needed for proper artifact handling and loading, as indicated by multiple test failures.
requirement.contract: The Artifact class should include all necessary attributes and methods required for artifact handling, including proper initialization and handling of artifact-specific properties that are accessed in the runner code.
requirement.acceptance: Multiple tests in test_runner.py and test_serialisers.py should pass
